pdfmake 0.2.20 browser build and bundled Roboto fonts.
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfmake/v/0.2.20
Loaded on demand by reading-pdf-worker.js. PDF generation stays in a browser worker so the interface remains responsive.
